final: WITH linked_fees AS (SELECT o.orderbase, f.feerate FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(feerate) AS average_rate FROM linked_fees), channel_averages AS (SELECT orderbase, AVG(feerate) AS average_rate FROM linked_fees GROUP BY orderbase) SELECT AVG(c.average_rate) AS mean_channel_fee_rate, AVG(c.average_rate - a.average_rate) AS mean_above_average FROM channel_averages AS c CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE c.average_rate > a.average_rate
